scripts.postinstall: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../api && npm install
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../api && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && npm run move-dist
scripts.move-dist: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('build', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.renameSync('frontend/dist', 'build');"
